# Optimity Technologies — AI, Product Engineering and Systems Integration for SMEs and Mid-Market Companies

> We build AI into the systems a business already runs. Optimity is a senior engineering team in India, the USA and the UAE working in three practices: AI & Automation, Product Engineering and Enterprise Solutions. Every engagement starts with a free, 30-minute Operations Teardown.

Optimity Technologies builds and deploys operational systems for SME and mid-market companies (roughly 50 to 500 people): software, AI and integrations that go into production, on top of the ERP, CRM and tools a company already uses. No rip-and-replace.

## Practices

- **AI & Automation**: assistants on a company's own documents and data, LLM integrations and private RAG, and workflow automation.
- **Product Engineering**: SaaS products and MVPs, web and mobile applications, platform and API design, cloud-native.
- **Enterprise Solutions**: ERP and CRM integration, Salesforce consulting, reporting and business intelligence, process automation.

## Products

- [Nexus AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/nexus-ai.html): plain-English questions across ERPNext, Odoo, HubSpot, PostgreSQL and documents, through three engines (DocIntellect AI™, SmartOps AI™, SQL Database Agent). Read-only queries, cited sources, private LLM deployment via vLLM, Clerk-based tenant isolation, row-level access control.
- [Move Concierge AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/move-concierge.html): voice and WhatsApp agent for movers and packers; takes enquiries, itemises inventory, quotes and books surveys.
- [Property Connect AI™](https://optimitytechnologies.com/property-connect.html): calls new real estate leads within a minute, qualifies them, warm-transfers to agents and books showings.

## How we work

- [How We Work](https://optimitytechnologies.com/how-we-work.html): six steps in three stages. Understand (understand the operation, design the system), Build (build, integrate), Operate (deploy, improve).
- [The Operations Teardown](https://optimitytechnologies.com/contact.html#book): free, 30 minutes. We look at the hand-offs between a company's systems and show where AI pays off and where it doesn't. The client keeps the teardown either way.

## Who it's for

- [Industries](https://optimitytechnologies.com/industries.html): logistics & distribution, retail & e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, real estate, professional services. Kinds of systems: workflow automation, document intelligence, decision support, compliance & audit.

## Ways of working

- [Why Optimity](https://optimitytechnologies.com/why-optimity.html): clients own what we build; no platform fee, no lock-in. Three engagement models:
  - **Product Studio**: we build and run the whole thing, from discovery to a system the team uses daily.
  - **Embedded Teams**: senior engineers working inside the client's team, on their tools, at their cadence.
  - **Strategic Advisory**: architecture reviews, build-or-buy decisions, fractional CTO or CPO work.

## Company & contact
